title: When the Signal Sings Revisited
author: Juniper Villalobos
blurb: Ivo Okonkwo, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
